title: Verify globe/next-keyboard key compliance
description: Apple mandates a way to switch to the next keyboard. Current extension has no needsInputModeSwitchKey globe button. iOS may handle via long-press globe, but reviewers may not know that. Need to verify behavior and possibly add a minimal globe button to avoid rejection.

title: Add standalone functionality to host app (Guideline 4.2)
description: Apple requires the container app to provide real standalone functionality beyond just housing the extension. Setup-instructions-only screen will likely be rejected. Need to add settings, keyboard preview, accessibility info, or utility features. This is the highest rejection risk.

description:
Rig identity bead for TinyKeyboard.

title: Create privacy policy
description: Required for all App Store submissions even if app collects nothing. TinyKeyboard collects no data, doesn't request Full Access, and has no network access. Should be straightforward.

title: Create App Store assets (icon, screenshots, description)
description: Need: real app icon art in AppIcon.appiconset, screenshots for 6.7" and 5.5" iPhone sizes, App Store description/keywords, category must be set to Utilities (required for keyboard extensions).

title: Prepare App Review note explaining intentional blank keyboard
description: Reviewers spend ~5 min per app. A blank keyboard will look broken. Need clear App Review note explaining this is an accessibility/voice-first tool, not a bug. One developer reported 10+ rejections before approval for a custom keyboard. Frame as accessibility keyboard for voice-input users.

title: Enroll in paid Apple Developer Program ($99/yr)
description: Free accounts can't publish. Need paid account for App Store submissions. Free account provisioning expires every 7 days.

title: Publish TinyKeyboard to the App Store
notes: Epic: All work needed to get TinyKeyboard published as a real App Store app. Includes Apple Developer Program enrollment, App Store requirements, review risk mitigation, and accessibility positioning.

title: No competing app exists in App Store
description: Research confirmed: no existing App Store app provides an invisible/zero-height keyboard for voice-first users. Existing voice keyboard apps (Breeze, Wispr Flow, ByeType, Typeless, VoiceInk) all add their own UI. TinyKeyboard fills a genuine gap, especially for the accessibility community. This is a differentiator worth highlighting in the App Store listing.

title: iOS autofill bar cannot be suppressed by keyboard extension
description: The autofill accessory bar (key/credit card/checkmark icons) that appears above the keyboard is rendered by iOS, not the keyboard extension. It's triggered by host app input field autocomplete attributes. For CHROTE (localhost:8080), adding autocomplete=off to input fields would suppress it. Device-level: Settings > Passwords > AutoFill can be toggled off. The keyboard extension has no API to control this.

title: System dock bar takes ~78pt even with 1pt keyboard
description: iOS renders a system UIKeyboardDockView beneath the keyboard extension containing globe icon, mic icon, and home indicator safe area (~34pt + ~44pt). This is outside the extension's view hierarchy and cannot be removed, resized, or recolored through any public API. The realistic minimum keyboard footprint is ~78pt, not truly invisible. Walking the superview chain to modify private views (UIInputSetHostView) is fragile and will cause App Store rejection. Users can disable mic via Settings > Dictation but globe cannot be removed when multiple keyboards are installed.
